Learn everything you need to know to be a competent Yin Teacher!

In this training, you will learn the know-how to teach Yin Yoga from your heart, based on the functional approach which recognizes that every body is unique and different. 55 hour Yoga Alliance Continuous Education (CEU) Credits available!

In this training, you’ll receive:

A Digital Manual

A Certificate of Completion

The Program Includes the following topics:

Fundamental Theory of Yin Yoga

Learn About Stillness, Silence, Willingness To Feel And Presence

Four Foundations Of Mindfulness (Mindfulness Of The Body, Mind, Emotions And Phenomena)

Creating Spaces And Understanding The Gift Of Time

Anatomy

Functional Anatomy Of Shoulders, Hips And Spine

How To Implement Skeletal Variations In Our Students

Range Of Motion: Learning How To Skillfully Analyze Anatomical Variations Into Pose Modifications

Exploring Edges In The Context Of Tension Vs Compression

Fascia – Latest Research And Findings And How It Relates To Yin Yoga

Teaching

Yin Poses Breakdown

Teaching Methodology

Yin Yoga Sequencing And Theming

Yin Language And Cueing

Practice Teaching

Learn To Hold Space For Others!

FAQ

Is this training only for yoga teachers?

No. This training is intended BOTH for certified Yoga Teachers with a formal 200h YTT, as well as for those without prior formal training. While the intention of this training is to allow yoga teachers to add yin yoga to their repertoires. The 55hr yin yoga training will certify you to teach yin yoga only (pending individual yoga studio policies).
